column5: What is "blue-green deployment"?
column6:
Running two identical environments and switching traffic between them. Blue is the current production. Green is the new version. Deploy to green, validate, then switch the load balancer/DNS to point at green. If green fails, switch back to blue instantly.

Remember: blue-green = two identical environments. Deploy to green, test, switch traffic. Rollback = switch back to blue. Zero downtime.

X vs Y: Blue-green (instant switch, 2x resources) vs canary (gradual rollout, less resources) vs rolling (in-place updates, no extra infra).
